name: 分布の中で学習の位置を知る
prompt: Create a refined version of the existing compact Lighthouse Japanese learning-position card, matching the exact 390×300 native preview, including its inset 358×288 card region and its geometry. The native preview is authoritative for wording and layout; the original Vocabulary screenshot is only secondary guidance for the shape of the score curve and marker, and its pale mint graph fill and pastel coloring must not be copied. The attached user example is palette guidance only: white surfaces, neutral gray inactive outlines, and a clear solid green active state; do not copy its circles or layout. Keep the canvas and card white with a thin light neutral gray outline (#D1D5DB), using near-black primary text and medium gray secondary text. Preserve exact copy and values: 学習者の4%より上にいます; あなたのスコア：29; あなた; 0; 平均; 100; 今すぐ練習する. Draw one crisp forest-green curve with no area fill or gradient, a small white-centered green user marker and vertical stem, light neutral axes and average guide, and the green primary button with white label overlapping the bottom card edge as shown. Maintain the compact spacing and responsive Japanese type. No pale tint fills, mint/cyan/tan/orange, shadows, texture, glow, illustration, gradients, added status bar, or extra copy.
reviewNotes: White chart card, light neutral outline, unfilled graph, and flat green line/marker/action; candidate awaits owner review.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
